resources.string:
New Feature: Character Images!
 		- You can now add an image to each character.
 		- Share your character image in other apps like WhatsApp.


How to add an image to a character:
 			- Open a character.
 			- Tap the camera icon 📷 to select an image from your device.
 			- The image will appear in the character preview.


How to view the image in full screen:
 			- Tap the character image.
 			- It will open in full screen mode.


How to share the image:
 			- Open the image in full screen.
 			- Tap the share icon at the top right.
 			- Choose the app you want to share it with.


Make your characters more immersive and personalize your battles like never before!
 Try it now and bring your party to life!
